title: Fitness accountability app
summary: Get matched with a buddy or coach to keep you exercising.
whyTempting: Everyone knows they should exercise and lacks motivation.
whyItFails: January spike. Signups surge then crash every year. Human coaching doesn't scale. Margins shrink with real coaches. Commitment fades. Accountability partners drift apart.
whatWouldChange: AI coaches that are actually motivating and cheap enough to scale.

attempts.notes: Gamified fitness social network; website offline by 2024.

attempts.outcome: Settled with the FTC over charging users
attempts.notes: Paid users for hitting exercise goals, funded by those who missed them.

reasons.detail: January spike: Signups surge then crash every year.
Human coaching doesn't scale: Margins shrink with real coaches.
Commitment fades: Accountability partners drift apart.
